title: Geometry
description: Class 4 IMO — Geometry: types of angles (right, acute, obtuse), parallel and perpendicular lines, parts of a circle, line symmetry, and nets of cubes and cuboids.

topics.title: Angles & Lines
topics.concept:
A right angle measures 90°, an acute angle is less than 90°, and an obtuse angle is more than 90° but less than 180°.

Parallel lines always stay the same distance apart and never meet, like railway tracks. Perpendicular lines cross each other making a right angle.

examples.solution: Less than 90°, so it is an acute angle.

examples.problem: What kind of lines are railway tracks?

recap: Parallel lines never meet; perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.

quiz.explanation: 120° is more than 90°, so it is obtuse.

topics.title: Parts of a Circle
topics.concept: The centre is the middle of a circle. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes right across through the centre and equals two radii (diameter = 2 × radius). A chord joins any two points on the circle, and the longest chord is the diameter.

examples.problem: A circle has a radius of 5 cm. What is its diameter?
What is the longest chord of a circle called?

recap: Radius = centre to edge; diameter = across through the centre.
Diameter = 2 × radius; the longest chord is the diameter.

quiz.q: If the radius is 7 cm, the diameter is ___ ?
The line from the centre to the edge of a circle is the ___ ?

topics.title: Symmetry & Nets
topics.concept:
A shape has line symmetry if a line splits it into two matching halves. A square has 4 lines of symmetry, a rectangle has 2, and a circle has many.

A net is a flat shape that folds into a solid. The net of a cube has 6 square faces, and the net of a cuboid has 6 rectangular faces.

examples.problem: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
How many squares are there in the net of a cube?

recap: Square has 4 lines of symmetry; rectangle has 2.
A net folds into a solid; a cube's net has 6 squares.

quiz.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
quiz.explanation: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

quiz.q: How many faces does the net of a cuboid have?
quiz.explanation: A cuboid has 6 faces, so its net has 6 rectangles.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are types of angle)?
questions.explanation: Parallel describes lines, not an angle; the others are angles.

questions.q: 45° is to acute as 120° is to ___ ?
A right angle is to 90° as a straight angle is to ___ ?
An angle less than 90° is called ___ ?
questions.explanation: An angle less than 90° is acute.

questions.q: If the radius of a circle is 6 cm, the diameter is ___ ?
The longest chord of a circle is the ___ ?
questions.explanation: The diameter is the longest chord.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.

questions.q: The corner of a book or a table top is an example of a ___ ?
questions.explanation: A corner makes a right angle (90°).

questions.q: At 3 o'clock, the two hands of a clock make a ___ ?
questions.explanation: At 3:00 the hands are at 90° — a right angle.

questions.q: A dice-shaped box has how many faces?
An angle of 90° and an angle of 30° are joined to make one angle of 120°. This new angle is ___ ?
questions.explanation: 120° is more than 90°, so it is obtuse.

questions.q: A circle has a diameter of 16 cm. What is its radius?
